person_updates.identity_evidence: The index supplies the uncommon Maurice Defenin name, literal Lt rank and French note. A French military-resistance index and a University of Limoges study document Maurice Fernand Défenin in the Lot resistance and intelligence administration, aligning on name, nationality, wartime setting and intelligence work. Neither source crosswalks Box 176 or explicitly identifies OSS service, so the match remains probable and no affiliation is published as settled fact.
person_updates.next_action: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. Compare Box 176 with French resistance file GR 16 P 164550 and Lot archival records before assigning the resistance or intelligence affiliation.
